kassakoppelingAuditLog.title: POS Kassakoppeling Audit Entry
kassakoppelingAuditLog.summary: Immutable append-only audit log entry for the Belastingdienst kassakoppeling compliance pack
kassakoppelingAuditLog.description: Represents a single POS register action (sale, void, refund, no-sale) signed with HMAC-SHA256 and linked into a SHA-256 hash chain per register. Mirrors the bookkeeping audit-trail-export pattern: every entry carries the previousHash (the prior entry's currentHash) so the auditor can replay the chain from genesis (previousHash='0') and detect any tampering. Together with posTransaction and the posZReport bookkeeping projection (the shillinq.JournalEntry.raise outcome) this gives the Dutch tax authority (Belastingdienst) a verifiable POS->shillinq integration trail. Entries are append-only by design — no PUT/PATCH endpoint exists and the controller refuses overwrites of any field other than the post-hoc `verified` flag and `exportedAt` timestamp. Mapped to Schema.org Action.

operatorId.description: Nextcloud user UID or external operator identifier driving the POS action
operatorId.title: Operator ID

registerNumber.description: POS register / terminal identifier (e.g. REG-001 / kassa-01); the hash chain is per-register
registerNumber.title: Register Number

amount.description: Transaction amount in cents (EUR); stored as integer to avoid float precision loss
amount.title: Amount

itemCount.description: Number of items affected by the action (0 for no-sale)
itemCount.title: Item Count

taxAmount.description: VAT / tax portion of the amount in cents (subset of amount)
taxAmount.title: Tax Amount

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the action was recorded (immutable, server-set on create)
timestamp.title: Timestamp

transactionUuid.description: Optional UUID reference to the parent posTransaction (cross-app linkage to pos-transaction-core)
transactionUuid.title: Transaction UUID

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of the canonicalised entry fields, computed server-side using KASSAKOPPELING_SECRET_KEY
signature.title: Signature

previousHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the prior entry's currentHash for this register, or '0' for the genesis entry
previousHash.title: Previous Hash

currentHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of this entry's canonicalised fields + previousHash; used to chain the next entry
currentHash.title: Current Hash

description.description: Optional operator notes (e.g. 'void: customer requested refund')
description.title: Description

verified.description: Cryptographic verification flag; null = pending, true = signature + hash chain valid, false = tampering detected
verified.title: Verified

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the entry was included in a Belastingdienst export
exportedAt.title: Exported At
